en_US: Are you raising different kinds of
Pokémon?
If you only have the same type of
Pokémon, you’ll have a hard time
against types it’s weak to.
Hi, has a Pokémon of yours ever been
put to sleep in the middle of a battle?
I teach at the Trainers’ School,
and I’d like to give you a lesson.
But before I do, I’d like you to
have this Berry.
A Lum Berry cures any status problem,
and confusion as well.
A Pokémon holding one eats it as soon
as it suffers a status problem.
But a Berry is gone once it’s eaten,
so it’s good for only one use.
Choose the Pokémon wisely when you
decide which one holds it.
Floaroma Town
